## Causal effects

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| fig-align: center

library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_light())
library(ggdag)
library(dagitty)
library(patchwork)
library(GGally)

gg_dag <- function(dag, base_size = 20) {
  ggplot(dag, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  geom_dag_edges() +
  geom_dag_point() +
  geom_dag_text() +
  theme_dag(
    base_size = base_size,
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
  )
  # expand_plot(expand_x = c(0.1, 0.1), expand_y = c(0.1, 0.1))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: dag-temp
#| fig-align: center

temp <- dagify(
  C ~ T,
  I ~ T,
  coords = list(
    x = c(C = 1, I = 2, T = 1.5),
    y = c(C = 1, I = 1, T = 2)
  )
)

gg_dag(temp)
```

## Directed acyclic graphs (DAGs)

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
-   **Graphical causal theory**.

-   **Nodes** represent variables.

-   **Edges** (arrows) represent causal effects (*directed*).

-   Causality flows "linearly", no circular causality (*acylic*).
:::

```{r}
#| label: dag-temp-2
#| fig-align: center

gg_dag(temp)
```

## Sentence length and subordination frequency

::: fragment

```{r}
#| label: dag-pandermaat
#| fig-align: center

temp <- dagify(
  L ~ C,
  S ~ C,
  coords = list(
    x = c(L = 1, S = 2, C = 1.5),
    y = c(L = 1, S = 1, C = 2)
  ),
  exposure = "L",
  outcome = "S"
)

gg_dag(temp)

```

:::

::: aside
C = discourse complexity, L = sentence length, S = subordination frequency. [@pandermaat2017]{.small-ref}
:::

## Four path types

```{r}
#| label: elemental
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| layout-nrow: 2
#| fig-align: center

# Adapted from https://solomon.quarto.pub/sr2/06.html#shutting-the-backdoor

d1 <- dagify(
  X ~ Z,
  Y ~ Z,
  coords = tibble(name = c("X", "Y", "Z"),
                  x = c(1, 3, 2),
                  y = c(1, 1, 2)))

d2 <- dagify(
  Z ~ X,
  Y ~ Z,
  coords = tibble(name = c("X", "Y", "Z"),
                  x = c(1, 3, 2),
                  y = c(2, 1, 1.5)))

d3 <- dagify(
  Z ~ X + Y,
  coords = tibble(name = c("X", "Y", "Z"),
                  x = c(1, 3, 2),
                  y = c(2, 2, 1)))

d4 <- dagify(
  Z ~ X + Y,
  D ~ Z,
  coords = tibble(name = c("X", "Y", "Z", "D"),
                  x = c(1, 3, 2, 2),
                  y = c(2, 2, 2, 1.05)))

p1 <- gg_dag(d1) + labs(subtitle = "The Fork")
p2 <- gg_dag(d2) + labs(subtitle = "The Pipe")
p3 <- gg_dag(d3) + labs(subtitle = "The Collider")
p4 <- gg_dag(d4) + labs(subtitle = "The Descendant")

# (p1 | p2 | p3 | p4) &
#   theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) &
#   plot_annotation(title = "The four elemental confounds") 

p1
p2
p3
p4
```

## The Fork: Z is a confound

```{r}
#| label: elemental-fork

gg_dag(d1)
```

## Confound: simulate

::: .columns

::: {.column width="40%"}

```{r}
#| label: confound-sim
#| echo: true

n <- 100

z <- rnorm(100)

x <- 0.4 * z + rnorm(100, 0, 0.1)
y <- 0.7 * z + rnorm(100, 0, 0.1)
```

:::

::: {.column width="60%" .fragment}

```{r}
#| label: confound-plot
#| fig-asp: 1
#| fig-align: center

conf <- tibble(x, z, y)

conf |> 
  ggplot(aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20))
```


:::

:::

## Confound: regression

::: columns
::: {.column}
```{r}
#| label: conf-lm-1
#| echo: true

conf_lm_1 <- lm(y ~ x, data = conf)
```

::: fragment
<br>

```{r}
coef(summary(conf_lm_1))[, 1:2] |> round(3)
```
:::

:::

::: {.column .fragment}
```{r}
#| label: conf-lm-2
#| echo: true

conf_lm_2 <- lm(y ~ x + z, data = conf)
```

::: fragment
<br>

```{r}
coef(summary(conf_lm_2))[, 1:2] |> round(3)
```
:::

:::
:::

## Confound: greater proficiency and code-switching

```{r}
#| label: pro-switch
#| fig-align: center

pro_switch <- dagify(
  S ~ P,
  coords = tibble(
    name = c("P", "S"),
    x = c(1, 2),
    y = c(1, 1)
  )
)

gg_dag(pro_switch)
```

::: aside
P = proficiency, S = code-switching. [@schachingertenes2023]{.small-ref}
:::

## Confound: multicultural context

```{r}
#| label: pro-switch-confound
#| fig-align: center

pro_switch <- dagify(
  P ~ C,
  S ~ C,
  coords = tibble(
    name = c("P", "S", "C"),
    x = c(1, 3, 2),
    y = c(1, 1, 2)
  )
)

gg_dag(pro_switch)

```

::: aside
C = multicultural context, P = proficiency, S = code-switching. [@schachingertenes2023]{.small-ref}
:::

## Confound vs moderator

```{r}
#| label: conf-mod
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-asp: 1
#| layout-ncol: 2

ggpairs(conf, upper = list(continuous = wrap(ggally_cor, stars = FALSE))) +
  labs(title = "Confound") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 20),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
  )

ggpairs(mod, upper = list(continuous = wrap(ggally_cor, stars = FALSE))) +
  labs(title = "Moderator") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 20),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
  )
```
